context: Two friends gossip at the cafe about a love confession
purpose: Teach: 告白/なぜか/何だか/あう/いまだに/貰っ/現に/伴っ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ聞いて、昨日カウンターで告白されちゃったんだけど。
lines.en: Hey listen, I got confessed to at the counter yesterday.
lines.style: Casual gossipy tone, leaning in conspiratorially across the table.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、嘘でしょ!? 何だか今日のあおいちゃん、いつもと雰囲気違うと思った!
lines.en: What, no way?! I thought you seemed different from usual today!
lines.style: Excited squeal with wide eyes, voice rising in genuine delight.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 常連さんなんだけどさ、なぜかずっと意識しちゃって、目もまともにあうのが恥ずかしい。
lines.en: He's a regular customer, but somehow I can't stop thinking about it.
lines.style: Sheepish half-whisper, blushing while stirring her coffee absently.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかる〜! 私もいまだに彼から初めて手紙を貰った日のこと忘れられないもん。
lines.en: I get it! I still can't forget the day I got his letter.
lines.style: Dreamy nostalgic sigh, hands clasped together near her chest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でも告白って責任も伴ってくるじゃん? 軽い気持ちで返事できないよ。
lines.en: But a confession comes with responsibility, right? I can't answer lightly.
lines.style: Serious lowered tone, expressing genuine worry about the situation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 現に向こうは勇気出してくれたんだから、ちゃんと向き合うのが大事だよ。
lines.en: He actually worked up courage, so facing him properly matters.
lines.style: Gentle but firm advice, reaching across to touch her friend's arm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん…ちょっと考える時間貰って、週末また会う約束したの。
lines.en: Yeah... I asked for time and we're meeting again this weekend.
lines.style: Quiet thoughtful murmur, gaze drifting toward the cafe window.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 応援してる! 結果どうなっても、絶対すぐ報告してね!
lines.en: I'm rooting for you! Tell me right away whatever happens, okay!
lines.style: Bright encouraging cheer, both hands raised in playful pom-pom gesture.
